title: Which minimum OS versions pre-built releases target?
author: loomweaver
body:
### Describe the feature or issue.

I am interested regarding the minimum OS requirements of pre-built touchHLE builds on Releases page.
Specificially the Windows/MacOS versions, since unlike Android, they don't contain built-in minSDK info.
Checked your documentation and FAQ, and found no information on this outside of "PC being relatively modern".
